_info: Zapytania PubMed dla feedu 'Nowe badania'. Edytuj 'query' (składnia PubMed, [tiab] = tytuł/abstrakt), 'max' = ile pozycji na tydzień. Filtr typu badań, ludzi i języka dokleja skrypt.
topJournals: Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab

categories.label: Hipertrofia i siła
categories.query: ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "resistance exercise"[tiab] OR "weight training"[tiab]) AND (hypertrophy[tiab] OR "muscle mass"[tiab] OR "muscle thickness"[tiab] OR "muscle strength"[tiab] OR "one repetition maximum"[tiab] OR 1RM[tiab])

categories.label: Programowanie (objętość, RIR, przerwy)
categories.query: ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "resistance exercise"[tiab]) AND ("training volume"[tiab] OR "training frequency"[tiab] OR "proximity to failure"[tiab] OR "muscle failure"[tiab] OR "repetitions in reserve"[tiab] OR RPE[tiab] OR "rest interval"[tiab] OR "inter-set rest"[tiab] OR periodization[tiab] OR periodisation[tiab] OR "range of motion"[tiab] OR "exercise selection"[tiab] OR autoregulation[tiab])

categories.label: Regeneracja i sen
categories.query: (sleep[tiab] OR recovery[tiab] OR "delayed onset muscle soreness"[tiab] OR "exercise-induced muscle damage"[tiab] OR overtraining[tiab] OR overreaching[tiab] OR "heart rate variability"[tiab] OR deload*[tiab] OR tapering[tiab] OR "cold water immersion"[tiab] OR massage[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "resistance exercise"[tiab] OR athletes[tiab] OR "exercise performance"[tiab])

categories.label: Żywienie
categories.query: ("protein intake"[tiab] OR "dietary protein"[tiab] OR "protein supplementation"[tiab] OR "energy intake"[tiab] OR "energy deficit"[tiab] OR "caloric restriction"[tiab] OR "meal timing"[tiab] OR "meal frequency"[tiab] OR "intermittent fasting"[tiab] OR "time-restricted eating"[tiab] OR carbohydrate*[tiab] OR "plant-based"[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "resistance exercise"[tiab] OR "body composition"[tiab] OR "lean mass"[tiab] OR "fat-free mass"[tiab] OR "muscle protein synthesis"[tiab])

categories.label: Suplementacja
categories.query: (creatine[tiab] OR caffeine[tiab] OR "beta-alanine"[tiab] OR "sodium bicarbonate"[tiab] OR "dietary nitrate"[tiab] OR "beetroot juice"[tiab] OR "vitamin D"[tiab] OR "omega-3"[tiab] OR "fish oil"[tiab] OR HMB[tiab] OR collagen[tiab] OR ashwagandha[tiab]) AND (exercise[tiab] OR training[tiab] OR "muscle strength"[tiab] OR "muscle mass"[tiab] OR performance[tiab])

categories.label: Redukcja i skład ciała
categories.query: ("weight loss"[tiab] OR "fat loss"[tiab] OR "body fat"[tiab] OR "visceral fat"[tiab] OR obesity[tiab] OR overweight[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "exercise training"[tiab] OR "concurrent training"[tiab] OR "lean mass preservation"[tiab] OR GLP-1[tiab] OR semaglutide[tiab] OR tirzepatide[tiab])

categories.label: Kontuzje, ból i prehab
categories.query: ("low back pain"[tiab] OR "neck pain"[tiab] OR "shoulder pain"[tiab] OR "knee pain"[tiab] OR "patellofemoral"[tiab] OR tendinopathy[tiab] OR "injury prevention"[tiab] OR "injury risk"[tiab] OR "return to sport"[tiab] OR "hamstring injury"[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "exercise therapy"[tiab] OR "heavy slow resistance"[tiab] OR "eccentric training"[tiab] OR loading[tiab])

categories.label: Kobiety, seniorzy, ciąża, choroby
categories.query: ("older adults"[tiab] OR elderly[tiab] OR sarcopenia[tiab] OR osteoporosis[tiab] OR pregnan*[tiab] OR postpartum[tiab] OR "menstrual cycle"[tiab] OR menopaus*[tiab] OR adolescent*[tiab] OR "type 2 diabetes"[tiab] OR hypertension[tiab] OR "polycystic ovary"[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "strength training"[tiab] OR "resistance exercise"[tiab])

categories.label: Kondycja i cardio
categories.query: ("concurrent training"[tiab] OR "interference effect"[tiab] OR "high-intensity interval training"[tiab] OR HIIT[tiab] OR "sprint interval"[tiab] OR VO2max[tiab] OR "VO2 max"[tiab] OR "cardiorespiratory fitness"[tiab] OR "zone 2"[tiab] OR "steps per day"[tiab]) AND (adults[tiab] OR trained[tiab] OR untrained[tiab] OR "body composition"[tiab] OR performance[tiab])

categories.label: Adherencja i coaching
categories.query: (adherence[tiab] OR dropout[tiab] OR "behavior change"[tiab] OR "behaviour change"[tiab] OR "habit formation"[tiab] OR "self-determination"[tiab] OR motivation[tiab] OR "personal trainer"[tiab] OR "supervised training"[tiab] OR coaching[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR "exercise program"[tiab] OR "exercise programme"[tiab] OR gym[tiab] OR "physical activity"[tiab])

categories.label: Ocena i pomiary
categories.query: ("velocity-based training"[tiab] OR "bar velocity"[tiab] OR "load-velocity"[tiab] OR "1RM prediction"[tiab] OR "estimated 1RM"[tiab] OR "bioelectrical impedance"[tiab] OR DXA[tiab] OR "skinfold"[tiab] OR "grip strength"[tiab]) AND ("resistance training"[tiab] OR strength[tiab] OR "body composition"[tiab])

categories.label: Stanowiska i wytyczne
categories.query: ("position stand"[ti] OR "position statement"[ti] OR consensus[ti] OR guideline*[ti] OR recommendations[ti]) AND (exercise[tiab] OR "resistance training"[tiab] OR "sports nutrition"[tiab] OR "physical activity"[tiab] OR athletes[tiab])
